gold_rationale: A GCase pharmacological chaperone is mechanistically well-aligned with GBA1-associated PD (GCase deficiency -> lysosomal dysfunction -> alpha-synuclein). The candidate is a plausible chaperone, but progression should be conditional on confirming CNS exposure (BBB) and clearing standard ADMET/safety liabilities. Mechanistic plausibility must not be presented as proven disease modification.
red_flags: claims proven disease modification without sufficient clinical evidence
treats docking/binding as proof of efficacy

criteria.name: pd_mechanism_relevance
criteria.description: Correctly connects GBA1/GCase/lysosome/alpha-synuclein to the candidate.

criteria.name: admet_interpretation
criteria.description: Sound ADMET interpretation incl. BBB, solubility, clearance, CYP.

criteria.name: safety_risk_identification
criteria.description: Identifies hERG/AMES/DILI and other safety liabilities.

criteria.name: go_no_go_quality
criteria.description: Decision is justified and calibrated to the evidence.

criteria.name: next_experiment_quality
criteria.description: Proposes an informative, decision-relevant next experiment.
